summary: Windows-only modules are compiled and called on every OS, against the rule that other OSes return Unsupported
evidence: platform/src/lib.rs:5 pub mod windows without cfg; commands.rs assess_file calls windows::files::file_facts directly; default_scan_target reads USERPROFILE
failure_scenario: On Linux or macOS assess_file performs a real metadata read instead of returning Unsupported; default_scan_target returns an empty string.
